tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i gdung mchod dang*/ phal par lho sgo'i sgo nas phan gdags pa'i cho ga gzhan phan 'od snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas bla ma dang*// dbyer med rdo rje sems dpa' la btud nas// bya sla 'bras chen de nyid mnyes thabs dang*// tshe 'das sdig sbyong cho ga bri bar bya// de la gnyis/ bla ma sogs gang zag mchog la mchod 'bul ji ltar bya ba dang*/ phal pa sdig sbyong gi lam bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ bla ma'i thugs dam bkrol mtshams las bum gyi chus gdung bkrus te/ dri bzang dang sman snas khyab par byug sbyin sreg rgyud sde gang yin gyi gnas yig so sor sbyar/ gdung ras dkris la longs spyod rdzogs sku'i chas kyis spras te khri la sogs pa'i steng du bzhugs su gsol/ rgyud sde gong 'og gi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kun rig mi 'khrugs sogs yin na bdag 'jug grub mtshams dang*/ kye rdor mkha' spyod ma sogs yin na bdag 'jug gi mjug gtor bsngos grub mtshams gdung rten gyi mdun du mchod rdzas rgyud sde rang rang nas 'byung ba bzhin bkod legs su bsham/ dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel na bdag bskyed rgyud sde gang yin dang*/ de'i bum pa bsgrub/ gang ltar yang sbyong chas dang*/ khrus bum sogs nyer bsdogs byas la/ kun rig la/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ dang*/ kye rdor la a mṛ tas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhi bar gshegs pa che ge mo zhes bya ba de nyid sku yi rnam pa gsal zhing yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su gshegs pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes de nyid stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa gang na bzhugs kyang bdag sogs 'gro ba sems can thams cad la thugs rjes gzigs te skad cig gis 'dir 'byon par mdzad du gsol/

hūm̐/ ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon gyur thugs rje'i bdag /theg chen byang chub thugs bskyed dam tshig dang*// bdag sogs dad mos gdung bas spyan drangs ngor// 'gro la brtse bas deng 'dir gshegs su gsol// rtag par 'dzin rnams sgyu ma'i dpes bskul phyir// gzugs sku btang nas mya ngan 'da' bzhed gang*// 'jig rten mgon rnams dga' ldan slar babs nas// sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ji bzhin 'dir 'jug gsol// 'gro ba kun la snying rjes sgrib sbyong phyir// zag med rdo rje'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs nas// srid pa bar ma'i gnas kun rab sbyangs te// sprul pas gdul bya skyong phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ gu ru badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhi bar gshegs pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes de nyid mar me lta bur bkug nas rten gyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ thugs kar thim pas bla ma'i sku dang ye shes dbyer med par gyur/ de nas sa lam la bar du gcod pa dang rjes 'brang gi bgegs sbyang ba ni/ sbyong chas bshams pa chab kyis bran te/ gtor ma g.yas su bskor la/ sarba bighnān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo sogs nas/ gṛhṇe daṃ ba lyā di swā hā lan gsum/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sa dang lam la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs zhi bas sbyong bar 'os pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ting lo changs bu g.yon du bskor la/ oṃ sumbha sogs lan gsum/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sogs nas/ bgegs zhi drag phyed mas sbyong bar 'os pa thams cad changs bu lam rgyags ting lo lam sgron gyi tshul du khyer la 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gal te mi 'gro na rdo rje'i khro bo rab tu 'bar bas bsreg cing brlag par gdon mi za'o// rang gi snying ga nas ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa'i sogs dang*/ chos nyid stong pa sogs dang*/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ yi dam gang yin brjod bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ dpal ldan bla ma de nyid sku 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i tshe na sku tshe thugs dam mdzad phrin la bar du gcod cing*/ gnas skabs zhi ba chos kyi dbyings su gshegs pa'i dus 'dir/ slob 'bangs shul pa rnams kyis tshogs gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos spyod bcu bsags pas zab dgongs chos dbyings su rdzogs par byed pa dang*/ mthar thug bstan 'gro'i bya ba rlabs po che mdzad pa'i sa lam gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad du gyur pa'i gdon bgegs log 'dren ye shes pa'i phyir 'brang gi bgegs dang bcas pa thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyong ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas des tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar zhing 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar dgas par bya'o// zhes dang rten la gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ rol mo drag tu bya/ sumbha sogs drag sngags mang du brjod pas bgegs dang bral bar bsam mo// de 'dra lan gsum bya/ de nas thog mar dkyil 'khor ram rten ring bsrel can la khrus gsol ba ni/ bum pa gnyis yod na rnam bum dang las bum bsres nas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis khrus gsol/

de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes pas sku phyi'o// de nas khrus byas pa'i chu de slar yang bum par blugs la bum chus nub gong ma rnams la me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la bkru zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs mchog la// nyon mongs dri ma mi mnga' yang*// sems can sgo gsum sgrib sbyang phyir// gtsang ma'i chab kyis sku khrus gsol// oṃ gu ru kā ya wāka tsitta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ oṃ gu ru kā ya wāktsitta a bhi sogs dang*/ kun rig dang mi 'khrugs pa lta bu yin na rtsa rig dang kaṃ ka ni dang*/ kye rdor dang mkha' spyod ma lta bur de ba pi tsu dang oṃ gsum ma brjod/ de bzhin du/ tshig rkang dang po dang gsum pa'i gnas su/ tshul khrims= bzod pa= brtson 'grus= bsam gtan= shes rab rnams gzhug rkang pa gnyis pa'i ser sna'i gnas su/ khrims 'chal/ khong khro/ le lo/ rnam g.yeng*/ shes 'chal rnams bcug la tshig bzhi pa lnga dang*/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi// yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// zhes sngags dang spel nas brjod/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhi bar gshegs pa/ zhes bya ba de nyid sangs rgyas kyi zhing sogs gang du gshegs bzhud mdzad pa'i phar phyin drug la mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dag nas sems can gyi don du sprul pa rgyun mi chad par mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa ston par gyur cig

de nas bum pa'i chus gtor/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des// khyed la= /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang la bde ba mnga' mdzad des// khyed la= /skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi// thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des// khyed= /gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi// sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des// khyed= /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur// gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' yang*// gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des/ khyed= /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa// phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor zhing*// don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des/ khyed= /gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yo zhing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyed= /byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yi mi bder gyur pa des// khyed= /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*// thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des// khyed= /yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ khyed= /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis// khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog

/khyed cag lam du bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur// khyed cag sdig par mar gyur cig /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhi bar gshegs pa de nyid kyi sa dang lam gyi spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig de nas rten gong ltar bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ kun rig yin na/ pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las de nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rab tu dges pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar stod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dril bu dkur brten pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsam/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi// chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang*// thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa'i// bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' gshegs su gsol// oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥgu ru badzra satwa e hye hi ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ shya ho sa ma ya st+waṃ/ zhes pas spyan drangs nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams bskal bar ldan// bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das// tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ gu ru badzra satwa ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐ swā hās mchod yon dbul/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ sku khrus gsol/ oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs rje'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul la/ lha la sogs pa dri yi rdzas// phyogs rnams kun na gang yod pa// tshim byed yid 'ong ldan pa 'di// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ badzra gandhe hūm̐/ zhing 'di'am rgya chen zhing gzhan na// lha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ba// chu dang thang skyes yid byung 'di// thub dbang= /oṃ badzra puṣpe hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas bdug spos rnams// lha rdzas spos kyi shing la sogs// dri zhim yid 'ong gang yod pa// thub dbang= /oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs rnams na// lha dang mi la sogs pa'i zas// yon tan kun ldan gang yin de// thub dbang= /oṃ badzra nai wi dya hūm̐/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu yi// rin chen mar me la sogs pa// snang ba'i khyad par gang yod de// thub dbang la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badzra ā lo ke hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod nas/ rdo rje thal mo dpral bar sbyar la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāktsitta pra ṇa me na badzra bandha naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes pas phyag byas par mos la/ sgo ba bzhi'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥs nam mkha'i lha mdun bskyed dang nye bar dgug oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐ gis gzhug oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ gyis phan tshun mi 'bral bar bcing*/ oṃ badzra ā be sha āḥlha rnams dbyer med du dbang du byas par bsam mo// mi 'khrugs pa yin na/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri'i steng du pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ de nyid rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog ind+ra nī la'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dwangs shing 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang ldan pa'i g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ spyan dkyus ring ba'i spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis 'gro ba mtha' dag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shing*/ zhal 'dzum zhing rab tu zhi ba/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma cung zad lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan pa dang bcas par gsal/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ dmigs med mkha' ltar sogs nas bandha naṃ ka ro mi'i bar gong ltar la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ gu ru badzra akṣo bhyaḥ.e hye hi/ zhes bsgyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ kye rdor yin na/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri'i steng du padma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ las thod pa dum bu gsum pa dpral bar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

de'i g.yon du am̐ las gri gug sngo nag yu ba la am̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las dpal kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar steng zhal dud ka zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan cing*/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal ka drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi bla gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskums pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid// de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskums pas yab la 'khyud pa/

gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpal kye rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzrī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las yab yum gnyis ka la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ mkha' spyod ma yin na/ stong pa'i ngang las e e las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo bam̐ yig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen la phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon pa la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍa ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chod khebs pa/

lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yam̐ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo sngags dang bcas pas gos zung 'bul/ mthar gang ser ma gdon/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad pa'i// bla ma khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// chos rnams kun gyi rin chen gter// dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// dpal ldan bla ma de la 'dud// khyod ni gdul bya smin pa'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa lnga// khyod kyi phung po rnam lngar ston// spyan sogs khyod kyi 'byung ba bzhi// sa yi snying po rdo rje 'chang*// nam mkha'i snying po spyan ras gzigs// 'jam dbyangs sgrib pa rnam par sel// byams pa kun tu bzang po rnams// mgon po khyod kyi dbang po sogs// gshin rje'i gshed sogs khro bo bcu// dpal ldan khyod kyi sku yi cha// gzugs sogs rdo rje lha mor /dngos po kun gyis de la 'dud// rnam pa kun tu bdag skyabs mchi// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na// lus dang longs spyod 'brel pa kun// srog gi bar gyis khyod mnyes bgyi// ji srid rnam par grol ba'i sa// bdag gzhan kun gyis ma thob bar// de srid mchod pa mchog gi sprin// kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las// ches lhag gyur pas khyod mchod do// khyod ni gang la mnyes gyur pa'i// phrin las de nyid sgrub par shog /mi mnyes byed pa rnam spangs te// rnam pa kun tu khyod bsten no// khyod kyi phrin las sgrub slad du// mgon po gang la mnyes gyur na// gal te bla na med pa yi// byang chub thob kyang de dor te// skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub par bgyi// dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun// khyod mnyes bgyid pa'ang thob par shog /sku yi spyod pa rnam dag pa// sangs rgyas dges pa'i tshul khrims ldan// gsung gi phrin las phun sum tshogs// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus khyab// thugs kyi dgongs pa rab zab pa// chos rnams kun gyi de nyid mkhyen// mkhas pa thams cad dga' mdzad pa'i// yon tan rgya mtsho khyed la mnga'// sems can thams cad smin mdzad pa'i// phrin las mnga' ba chos kyi rje// khyed la bsu bas dpal du byed// bsten pas blo gros mchog tu 'gyur// brten na 'jigs pa med par mdzad// bsnyen bkur bgyis pas bde ba 'byung*// de 'dra'i dpal ldan chos kyi rje// bla ma mchog la bdag gsol 'debs// mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni// bla ma mchod pa bya'o zhes// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs// de bas dngos po thams cad kyis// bla ma mnyes par byed par shog /skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan// ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar// de srid bla ma'i zhabs drung du// 'bral ba med par gnas gyur cig /mchod pa kun gyis mchod byed cing*// dam chos rtag tu nyan pa dang*// bka' bzhin sgrub pa'ang byed par shog

/phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs pa yi// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la// rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// thog ma bar dang mthar dge zhing*// rnam par dkar la ma 'dres pa// nges par 'byung ba mchog gi lam// dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams zhing rab mchog gyur pa// lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i gnas// rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra bcom pa// tshogs mchog dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal// tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan zhing*// ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gnas// bde gshegs bstan pa legs 'dzin pa'i// bshes gnyen kun la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas dang*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgras// bla ma'i tshogs dang dkon mchog mchod// 'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas par// bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i// mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis pa// blo yis blangs nas dbul bar bgyi// rab dang yid las byung gyur pa'i// mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po ni// mkha' dang mnyam pa du ma yis// yon tan rgya mtsho sras bcas mchod// dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba'i// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /ces dang*/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla mar mchod// oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du me tog

bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ sil snyan rnams dang*/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shabda rnams bcug pas mchod cing*/ dharma ra ṇi ta sogs rol mo bya/ oṃ sarba bitpū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya hoḥ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra ratna pū dzi te hūm̐/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren cing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /ma ṇi ratna/ btsun mo rin chen 'di= /ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wasti ratna= blon po rin chen= /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /ma hā ta ratna= glang po rin chen= /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg pa rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti ratna= rta mchog rin chen= /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod par shog /a shwa ratna= dmag dpon rin chen= /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /khaṅga ratna= zhes rgyal srid bdun dang*/ maṇḍal 'dir bya ba'am/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams// mos blos sogs 'gre/

sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku// mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes// bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan// bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs// 'gag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan// mu stegs ri dwags skrag mdzad pa// bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra// bde gsal mi rtog ngang tshul ldan// rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa// bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku la tshad med bgrang du med// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur cing*// sna tshogs dbang phyug mi shigs pa'i// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// brjod du med pa'i ngang nyid las// tshangs pa la sogs snyan pa'i mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can// thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad// yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa// dri med mi g.yo mnyam nyid dam pa'i mchog chos can// yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de// dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bsgrun du yod ma yin// dngos grub mtha' yas dpag med dpe dang bral ba rnams// sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol// rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung*// smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can// 'gro ba'i don sgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang*// tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi// bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang*// khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog rnams stsol mdzad pa'i// thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo'i 'gag par yong mi 'gyur// e ma ho shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan// mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa// khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad// mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas// dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yang dag yon tan rgya chen te// lan cig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang*// sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ sgos bstod kyang*/ kun rig la/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun// rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang*// phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems dpar bstod// mi 'khrugs par/ chos dbyings mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rjes rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bar// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don sgrub lhur mdzad pa// bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal bstod// kye rdor la/

thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i// kye yi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// mkha' spyod mar/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa la sogs pa skabs su gang bab pas bstod/ bshags pa ni/ thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba ci bgyis pa dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ pha dang ma la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang*/ gsung rab kyi glud zos pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skur pa btab pa la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i sdig pa dang nyes pa dang*/ ltung ba'i tshogs ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ gzhan bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba bgyis pa de dag thams cad/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so// mi 'chab bo// slad chad bsdam par bgyid lags so// shes shing nus na/

gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du// sogs kyang brjod/ thun mong du ji snyed su dag sogs bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa bya'o// 'dir bla ma de nyid kyi gsol 'debs rnams 'don/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin na rgyang 'bod kyi gsol 'debs drag tu byas mthar/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi nyon mongs pa mtha' dag zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ chos thos bsam sgom gsum nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro bar byin gis brlab tu gsol/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa spyan gyis 'bras bu bzhin du bsrung nus par= theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la dad gus bsam gyis mi khyab pa bdag gi rgyud la skye bar= dad gus bsam mi khyab par thob par= byang chub sems nyams pa med pa bdag gi rgyud la skye ba gnas pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar bstan pa'i chos mtha' dag bdag gi rgyud la skye ba gnas pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar= bde gsal mi rtog pa'i mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan pa bdag gi rgyud la skye bar= mtshan nyid rig pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa bdag gi rgyud la skye bar= theg pa chen po gsang sngags mtha' dag gi snod du rung bar= mngon par shes pa rgya chen po thob par= sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par= thob nas kyang sems can nam mkha' dang mnyam pa smin par byed nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ kun rig mi 'khrugs sogs rgyud sde 'og ma'i skabs/ bla ma'i gnas gsum las sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyis rang gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs par bsam/

rgyud sde 'og ma la/ dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// bdag sogs 'gro la thugs rjes nyer dgongs te// bum gsang shes rab ye shes de kho na'i// ye shes mchog gis bdag rgyud gtams par mdzod// ces gsol ba gdab/ dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du dang*/ dbang po so so'i rang skal gyi dri ma sbyong tshul/ lam nyams len la dbang tshul/ dbang gi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi ye shes thob tshul sogs tshig rjes su don dran bzhin pas/ gu ru'i spyi bo'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi spyi bor thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim pas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ lam rtsa rlung bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam thig le bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ slar yang gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ ces dbang blang*/ rjes kyi rim pa la/ sri zhu 'bul zhing smon lam gsol ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur cing dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang ldan pa dpal ldan bla ma brgyud par bcas pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnams kyis dkon mchog la mchod pa phul ba dang*/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bgyis pa dang*/

'byung po la gtor ma btang ba dang*/ srung sdom dang*/ bzlas brjod dang*/ thos bsam dang*/ sgom sgrub la sogs pa bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ci bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus shing bzlums te bsdoms nas rigs kun khyab bdag 'dren mchog mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// phul bas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi thugs dgongs khyad par can rnams gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig sa dang lam gyi rim pa'i spang bya dang gegs dang sgrib par gyur pa ci mchis pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig lam lnga sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi don du myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig sems can thams cad kyi don gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa'i sku'i mdzad pa rgyun mi chad par gyur cig der yang sku tshe'i 'du byed bskal pa rgya mtshor g.yo med du brtan cing ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa mtha' yas pas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rlabs po che mdzad par gyur cig bdag cag rnams la'ang bla ma la brten pa'i sgo nas bsags pa'i nyes pa sku la bsdos pa/ rigs la bsnyags pa/ gsung ngag gcags pa/ nyes pa gtam du brjod pa/ thugs tshod bzung ba/ thugs sun phyung ba la sogs pa nyes pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig tshe rabs thams cad du yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal bar gyur cig mjal nas kyang mnyes par byed par gyur cig mi mnyes pa skad cig kyang byed par ma gyur cig skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig gzung du gtub par gyur cig gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pas skyong bar gyur cig bskyang du gtub par gyur cig tshe rabs thams cad du dge ba'i bshes gnyen mi brjed pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur cig

dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam par thar pa la longs spyod par gyur cig mthar sems can thams cad kyi don du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod/ myur 'byon yod na skabs 'dir 'don no// nongs pa bshags shing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ bdag blo gti mug rmongs pa'i dbang gyur te// legs spyad 'di la nyes par gyur pa gang*// skyes mchog rin chen rnams dang de yi sras// bdag nyid chen po rnams la bzod par gsol// ces yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod la/ 'o mchog gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhi bar gshegs pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos pa/ zhes bya ba de nyid deng 'dir gzhi'i 'od gsal gsal stong zung 'jug chen po'i dbyings su lam gyi 'od gsal skye med blo 'das zung du 'jug ste/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal gnyis med khyab gdal chos sku'i klong yangs 'gro 'ong g.yo 'gul bral bar mnyam par gzhag pa 'di las/ da nas bzhengs te sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa'am/ mkha' spyod dag pa'i gnas su gshegs te byang chub kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho skad cig gis rdzogs nas mi gnas pa'i zung 'jug mthar phyin par mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gshegs pas rgyal ba rgya mtsho mnyes pa'i mchod pa dang*/ phrin las bla na med pa bsgrubs nas der yang zhi ba'i dbyings su mi gzhol bar mdzad du gsol/ spyir du ma gyur sems can thams cad kyi khams rnams gang la gang 'dul de la der ston mi zad rgyan 'khor rnam pa lnga'i sprul pa 'byams su klas pa nam mkha' ji srid bar 'gag pa med par ston pa dang*/ khyad par zhing 'di'i gdul bya ris su ma chad pa rnams dang*/ yang sgos rjes su slob cing dad mos gus par ldan pa'i sems can rnams yal bar mi 'dor bar mdzad du gsol/ gnas skabs der yang phyi nang gi rkyen nag po'i bdud kyi 'tshe bas mi gnod cing thos bsam sgom gsum phar phyin drug sdom pa gsum bskyed rdzogs stong nyid snying rje sogs mthar phyin cing*/

mdzad pa phrin las dar zhing rgyas pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang*/ bye brag gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'di nyid kyi nyams pa gso ba dang*/ gnas pa phyogs dus kun tu rgya cher spel ba dang*/ gdul bya rnam mang mtha' yas pa rnams kyang byang chub chen po'i lam du 'dren par 'gyur ba'i thugs bskyed rgya chen po dang smon lam mtha' gang btsan g.yel ba med par gsol ba 'debs pa lags/ zhes pas dam ye dbyer med dag pa'i zhing du gshegs nas der bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur par mos la thugs yid bsres te mnyam par bzhag de nas bsngo smon bya ba ni/ bzang spyod sogs theg chen thun mong dang*/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sogs theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i smon lam gdab/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na rjes kyi cho ga rnams bya zhing*/ gang ltar bkra shis rgyas par brjod la dge legs su bya'o// 'di ni rang la bka' drin che ba'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang*/ skyes chen gzhan don yang srid 'byon pa gtsor byas nas bkod pa ste/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzhan la sham bu 'dod gsol smon tshig rnams gnas skabs dang bstun pa'i 'dor len shes dgos pa yin no// ༈ /gnyis pa phal ba'i sgrib sbyong lam bstan ni/ thog mar yi dam gang byed kyi bdag mdun bum gsum dang*/ bdag 'jug bcas grub pa'i rjes su/ sngar sbyor ba'i skabs su dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su sbyong stegs khru gang ba'i padma dkar po 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa bri/ de'i steng du rus pa'am ming byang bzhag sbyong ba'i yo byad dang*/ bye ma'am yungs kar sogs gshin don la dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad bsham mo// bzlas pa'i skabs rnams su bye ma'am yungs kar la sngags kyis brims la bzhag go /de nas ming byang la sogs pa'i rten de/

rang gzhung las sngags kyis bsang*/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sbyong stegs kyi steng du tshe 'das kyi ming gi yi ge dang po'am/ ṇi las tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur par bltas la/ rang bdag bskyed gang yin gyi snying ga'i sa bon dang*/ tshe 'das kyi snying ga'i ṇi las 'od 'phros pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes khams gsum gang na gnas pa nas bkug par bsam/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ ngag tu/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi/ bcom ldan 'das yi dam gang yin de'i mtshan nas smos te/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba khams gsum skye gnas bzhi rigs drug gang na gnas kyang skad cig gis 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥzhes brjod/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas khro bo'i tshogs spyan drangs par bsams la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal// log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// oṃ badzra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e hye his spyan drangs/ oṃ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul/ oṃ arghaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shabda hūm̐ gis mchod/

hūm̐/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*// thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngams stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod// bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dpa' bo stang stabs brkyang bskums tshul du bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyur 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs// khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang sogs gong ltar la/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyi tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i sdig sgrib sbyong ba la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa de dag la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyong ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas des tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar dgas par bya'o// zhes dang*/

rten la gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ rol mo drag tu bya zhing*/ ngag tu/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐/ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bidyā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ yi dam gang yin gyi drag sngags mang du brjod pas bgegs dang bral bar bsam mo// de nas tshe 'das kyi sdig pa thams cad kaṃ nag po'i rnam pas sna bug nas 'thon/ sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pas til la thim/ de g.yas su me dang*/ g.yon du chur dor bas sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs par bsams la/ oṃ sarba pā pam̐ da ha na badzra ye swā hā/ mkha' spyod la/ oṃ badzra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas mer bsreg cing chur dor ro// de nas bye ma'am yungs kar la rang rang gi lha sngags mang du bzlas pa de'i nus pa bstims la/ rus pa'am ming byang mdun du bzhag pa la brabs te/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇā ni bhasmiṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ brum̐ bi nā sha ya ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ druṃ bi sho dha ya ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la ta ka ta ka ha na ha na ā pa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sruṃ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ ha ra ha ra sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni bi spho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bhṛ ta bhṛ ta sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tstshinda tstshinda sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga ti he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga ti he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tirya ka ga ti he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dag par gyur cig ces brjod do// de nas thog mar dkyil 'khor la me long bstan te rten khrus bya ba ni/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzad// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis khrus gsol/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dhi na swā hā/ zhes pas sku phyi'o// de nas khrus byas pa'i chu de slar yang bum pa'i nang du blugs la/ de nas zhag grangs byed na bum chus nub gong ma rnams la me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la bkru/ tha ma la rten la dngos su bkru zhing*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o// rang rang gi sngags dang*/ de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po dang gsum pa'i gnas su/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab rnams gzhug rkang pa gnyis pa'i gnas su khrims 'chal/ khong khro/ le lo/ rnam g.yeng*/ shes 'chal rnams bcug la tshig bzhi pa lnga dang*/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi// yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// zhes bya ba'i tshig bzhi pa re dang chog gzhung gang yin gyi sngags spel zhing bkrus nas/

mthar tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug mi mthun phyogs dag nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo// tshig rkang gsum pa dang bzhi par/ bcom ldan dam chos/ dam chos bden pas dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun/ dge 'dun bden pas/ zhes sogs sbyar ba'i tshig bzhi pa gnyis brjod cing*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ che ge mo'i nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad bcom nas dge ba gsum dang ldan par gyur cig sa 'di dug gi pha yin te// sa 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum sa yi nang du seng*// chu me rlung du 'don pa bsgyur ba'i tshig bzhi pa gsum brjod pa'i rjes su/ tshe las 'das pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas skyes pa'i nyon mongs dang rnam rtog rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i chos nyid kyi ngang du thim nas sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig ces bya ba dang*/ bum pa'i chus gtor/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des// khyed la= /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang la bde bar mnga' mdzad des// khyed la= /skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi// thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des// khyed la=

/gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi// sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des// khyed la= /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur// gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la// gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des// khyed la= /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa// phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor cing*// don 'grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyed la= /gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yo zhing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyed la= /byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des// khyed la= /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*// thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des// khyed la= /yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyed la= /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis// khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam du bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur// khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i skye dgu thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu rgyal zhing bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod la/ 'o tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba khyod nyon cig de yang spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag par gsungs shing*/

bye brag tu 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i tshe la nges pa med pa dang*/ khyad par du khyed rang gi tshe dang las dang bsod nams kyi 'phen pa gsum ga zad pa'i stobs kyis tshe'i dus byas nas da lta srid pa bar ma do na yod pa shas che ba yin/ de'ang 'chi srid dang skye srid gnyis kyi bar du byung bas bar srid ces bya ba yin la/ de'i rnam gzhag ni mngon pa mdzod las/ sngon dus srid 'byung sha tshugs can// zhes gsungs zhing*/ sa'i dngos gzhir yang*/ gang du skye bar 'gyur ba de'i byad gzugs so// zhes gsungs pas/ rigs drug gang du skye bar 'gyur ba de'i sha tshugs 'dzin pa ste/ srid pa 'pho ba'i mdo las/ dmyal ba'i bar do sdong dum mes tshig pa lta bu dang*/ yi dwags kyi bar do chu lta bu dang*/ dud 'gro'i bar do du ba lta bu dang*/ mi'i bar do gser lta bu dang*/ lha'i bar do snam bu dkar po lta bu'i snang ba 'char bar gsungs la/ lam 'bras kyi gzhung bshad rnams las ni 'od dam snang ba dkar po la sems zin dmyal ba/ ser po la zin na yi dwags/ sngon po la zin na byol song*/ dmar po la zin na lha/ ljang gu la zin na lha ma yin/ sna tshogs la mir skye 'gyur gyi bar do yin par bshad do// gzhan yang mdzod las/ rigs mthun lha mig dag pas mthong*// zhes gsungs pas bar srid de bar do nang mthun pa dang*/ lha'i mig dag pa'i mngon shes kyis mthong la gzhan gyis mi mthong ba yin/ las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan// zhes gsungs te/ rnam shes rlung gi bzhon pa can des bsam pa tsam gyis stong gsum thams cad skad cig la bgrod par nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs dang ldan pa yin/ dbang po kun tshang thogs med rgyu// zhes pa ni yid kyi lus can mig la sogs pa'i dbang po lnga tshang zhing ri rab khang khyim sogs la thogs med du rgyu yang*/ las las grub pa ma'i mngal la sogs pa skye gnas bzhi la thogs/ byin rlabs las grub pa rdo rje gdan lta bu la thogs par bshad/

mi ldog de ni dri za'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don mi ldog ces pa ni/ rigs drug gang du skye 'gyur gyi bar do'i snang ba shar nas skye gnas gzhan du ldog mi srid de/ der las stobs ldan gsog pa'i nus pa med pa'i phyir/ zhes bzhed la/ mngon pa gong ma ba rnams ni ci ste na ldog go /de na yang las gsog go /zhes gsungs pas skye gnas gzhan du ldog pa'i nus pa yod cing bar dor las dge sdig gsog pa'ang yod par bshad/ dri za'o zhes pa'i don ni/ bar do'i gnas skabs su kha zas rags pa la longs spyod pa med cing*/ dbang che chung gi bye brag gis dri bzang ngan za ba tsam zhig yod do// de dag ni theg pa thun mong ba la grags pa tsam zhig yin la/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag rnams las/ bar dor 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi/ nyam nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum ste rkyen bdun 'char bar bshad/ de la 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi ni/ sa chu la thim pas ri bo rab tu grum pa'i sgra/ chu me la thim pas bskal pa 'jig pa'i rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i sgra/ me rlung la thim pas dus mtha'i me lta bu'i sgra/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pas dud mtha' rlung lta bu'i sgra 'byung ba yin/ nyam nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnams kyang g.yang sa 'jigs shing ya nga ba mthong nas bdag nyid der lhung ba'am/ lhung gis dogs pa la sogs pa'i 'jigs skrag bsam gyis mi khyab par 'byung zhing*/ de'i rkyen gyis skyabs 'tshol ba'i snang ba 'byung bas/ de'i dus su skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum dran pa gal che ba yin/ gzhan yang khyod bar do na yod pa'i rtags ni/ nang na khams dkar dmar med pas phyi rol tu nyi ma dang zla ba'i snang ba mi 'byung*/ gdos bcas kyi lus med pas grib ma dang rjes mi 'byung*/ zag bcas kyi mngon shes cung zad yod pas bla ma dang mchod gnas rnams kyi sems kyi rgyu ba ngan pa rig nas/

ma dad pa'i dbang gis ngan song du 'gro nyen yod pas dad pa brtan pa gal che ba yin/ gzhan yang nye 'brel rnams kyi rtsar song nas phar gtam brjod kyang tshur lan mi 'debs pas/ de dag gi sems la brtags nas rnam rtog bzang ngan gang rgyu ba shes shing*/ rang dbang ba'i nor rdzas rnams gzhan gyis khyer ba la sogs pa mthong nas chags sdang drag po skye/ des mtshams sbyar te dmyal bar skye srid pas bar do'i 'khrul snang du shes par gyis la/ gang la'ang chags sdang ma byed/ de lta bu'i bar do'i tshe'i tshad la nges pa med kyang*/ btsun pa dbyig bshes kyi bzhed pas ni/ bar do na zhag bdun gnas pa'i zhag phyed dang bzhi yan chad tshe snga ma'i bag chags shas che zhing*/ de phyin chad phyi ma gang du skye 'gyur gyi snang ba 'char zhing*/ des ni skye ba'i tshogs pa rnyed na lus len/ ma rnyed na zhag bdun phrag re'i mtshams su 'chi chung re dang bar dor yid lus re len/ de lta bu'i bdun phrag bdun gyi bar du gnas la/ de nas rigs drug gang rung du skye ba len pa shas che zhing*/ kha cig ni bskal pa'i bar du bar dor gnas pa'ang yod par bshad/ gang ltar yang rnam shes rlung gi bzhon pa can de nyid la lus rten rags pa med pas/ bya sgro rlung gis bskyod pa ltar rang dbang du mi gnas pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pas nyen te/ skye gnas 'tshol ba'i bya ba 'ba' zhig byed pas/ de'i gnas skabs su bar do la bar do yin par ngo shes par byas nas skye gnas ngan pa la ma zhen pa gal che ba yin/ mdor na rang dga' ma'i shes pa bdun 'gyur las rmi lam gyi shes pa gsal/ de bdun 'gyur las bar do'i shes pa gsal zhing*/ lus kyi 'ching ba dang bral bas rkyen cung zad kyis kyang grol nus par bshad pa'i phyir na dngos grub len pa'i dus shig la bar do bzang ba yin la/ dngos grub blang ba'i yul ni skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum yin pas/

de dag la sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ dbang bskur zhu ba'i 'dun pa drag po gyis/ de nas bu la sogs pa'i nye du yod na ming byang 'dzin du bcug cing phyag byed du bcug la/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa rnam sel bar// bdag ni skyabs su mchi lags so// de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad pa// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin tshe 'das skyabs su mchi// tshe 'das 'jigs pa cher mthong nas// kun tu bzang la tshe 'das 'bul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la tshe 'das kyi// lus 'di bdag gis dbul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul pa'i// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan 'di la bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje'i bdag nyid thams cad la// phyag 'tshal snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrag nas phyogs bcur 'byer byed pa// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas/ khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// sdig pa thams cad sbyang du gsol/ lam bstan du gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes snying thag pa nas brjod cing gsol ba 'debs par bsam mo// de nas gshin po la dbang bskur na rang rang gi chog gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar bya/

mi bskur na/ byang bu bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las skabs thob gdan gyi steng du tshe 'das rang gzhung gi lhar bskyed/ mchod bstod bya/ de nas 'dod yon lnga bsang sbyang*/ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis brlab/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos mchod gnas lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shig bla med byang chub thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig shabda= phyogs dus kun na tsandan sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig= /gandhe= phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig= /ra sa= /phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig= /sparshe= zhes pas mchod do// thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du// longs spyod zad pa med par shog /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med pa// rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /ces brjod/ de nas byang bu bsreg pa'i brda sprod byed na/ slar yang 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs pa de spyi gtsug nas 'thon te mdun gyi nam mkhar gnas par bsam/ de nas chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros bral du shes par byas te/ de'i ngang nas 'khrul ngor snang ba'i tshe las 'das pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad kyi ngo bo tha mal pa'i gzugs kyi rnam pa can nam/ ming byang gi rnam pa bsreg cing sbyar du rung ba dpe bud shing dang chos mtshungs su gnas pa de nyid/

slob dpon gyi chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes pa'i bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes rang bzhin 'od gsal ba sbyong byed me dang chos mtshungs su yod pa des/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i gzugs byang de nyid bsregs shing sbyangs pas 'khrul pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad ye shes kyi snang ba chen po gcig tu 'bar ba la brten nas tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba de nyid skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa'i zhabs drung du 'khod de gsal stong 'dzin med du cung zad mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mes// tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing dang*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa// ye shes snang bar 'bar gyur cig /ces dang*/ rang sngags brjod cing bsreg mi 'khrugs pa yin na/ rnam par shes pa mi 'khrugs par gsal ba de nyid skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du skad cig gis mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i zhabs drung sogs dang*/ mkha' spyod mar/ rnam par shes pa rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba de nyid skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du skad cig gis mkha' la spyod pa'i zhing khams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs drung sogs bsgyur/ kye rdor dang mkha' spyod ma yin na/ kye/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu// phung po lnga yi bud shing la// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro// nyon mongs lnga yi bud shing la// mkha' 'gro lnga yi mi sbar ro// rnam shes brgyad kyi bud shing la// ye shes lnga yi me sbar ro// 'byung ba lnga yi bud shing la// lha mo lnga yi me sbar ro// zhes dang*/ kye rdor la de wa pi tsu dang*/ mkha' spyod mar oṃ gsum ma brjod cing bsreg go /de nas lam sbyang bstan bya ste/

nub gong ma rnams la mchod pa'i rjes la bya/ nub tha ma la byang bu bsregs pa'i rjes la bya ste/ dril bu gsil/ me tog gtor/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam// rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te// 'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog /oṃ ratne ratne ma hā ratne/ ratna saṃ bha we/ ratna ki ra ṇe/ ratna mā la bi shuddhe/ sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ tra tha/ zhes dang*/ rol mo bya/ padma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i// srid pa'i padmo las byung ba'i// bde ba can du skye bar shog /oṃ padme padme padma saṃ bha we ma hā su kha ba tī gatstshantu swā hā/ zhes brjod nas rol mo byas te bde ba can du skyes par bsam/ der skyes pa'i byang sems rnying pa rnams kyis phyis kyi de la mchod par bsams la/ mchod cing rol mo bya/ des kyang sangs rgyas 'od dpag med 'khor bcas la mchod cing rol mo bya/ der skye ba'i rgyu brtags pas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi cho ga'i nus pa yin par shes te rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dir 'ongs nas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor la mchod cing rol mo byas la/ e ma sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas// e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs// gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs// byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /ces ched du brjod par bsam/ bdag gis kyang slar de la mchod pas mchod cing rol mo bya/ slar bde ba can du song bar bsams la me tog dor/ mi 'khrugs pa yin na/ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing dang*/ mkha' spyod ma yin na/ mkha' spyod chen mo'i zhing sogs bsgyur/ de nas tshe 'das kyi don du bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa'i smon lam rgyas par brjod cing*/

'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyi rgyas btab ste gshin po rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga'o// rjes ni rang rang gi cho ga gzhung ltar bya'o// tshe 'das kyi rus bu'am byang bu bsregs thal la sātstsha btab ste sbyong khrus rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang*/ rten bskyed/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i steng du/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i chos sku'i mchod rten yangs shing rgya che bar gyur pa'i bum pa'i nang du dbus su seng ge/ shar du glang po che/ lhor rta/ nub tu rma bya/ byang du mkha' lding rnams kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i gdan re re dang bcas pa'i dbus su rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ shar du mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ lhor rin 'byung ser po g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur ces dang*/ sku gzugs kyi rten yin na/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bskyed/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'am/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing sogs rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya/ mchod de/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes lan mang du brjod cing so so la thim par bsam/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lnga so so dang*/ sku gzugs kyi rten rnams la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sogs kyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med sogs rigs lnga'i bstod pa gang shes dang*/ lha sku gang yin na/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' sogs kyis bstod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas lha rnams kyi spyan 'byed pa'i tshul byas la/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsakṣu tsakṣu sa manta tsakṣu bi sho dha ne swā hā/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa thob ste sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig
